title: "[Process Doc Update]: Create README for OctoAcme Project Management Docs with Process Summary and Links"
body: |
  ## Which process document do you want to update?
  **<new document>** - Creating a new README.md for the docs/ folder

  ## Summary of New Content
  A comprehensive README.md file for the OctoAcme Project Management documentation folder that serves as a central hub and entry point. This README provides:
  - A brief overview of OctoAcme's project management approach and principles
  - A curated list of links to all project management process documents stored in the docs/ folder
  - A quick reference guide for new team members and stakeholders
  - Improved discoverability and navigation of existing process documentation

  ## Why is this update needed?
  Currently, the process documentation exists as separate files in the docs/ folder, but there is no central entry point or index. A README provides:
  - **Clarity**: New team members can quickly understand the overall PM approach before diving into specific processes
  - **Accessibility**: A single source of truth for accessing all project management docs
  - **Navigation**: Clear links make it easier to find relevant processes for different project phases
  - **Scalability**: As the documentation grows, a README provides a foundation for organization

  ## Suggested Content
  A README with the following sections:
  - Quick Start guide for new and returning users
  - Complete Project Management Lifecycle with links to each phase
  - Key Resources (Overview and Personas)
  - OctoAcme Project Management Summary highlighting:
    - Core Principles (customer-first, iterative delivery, clear ownership, data-informed, psychological safety)
    - Key Roles (PM, PdM, Developers, QA, Stakeholders)
    - Communication Cadence (weekly syncs, twice-weekly standups, monthly updates)
    - Key Artifacts (charters, roadmaps, backlogs, risk registers, retrospectives)
  - Usage guide for different project phases
  - Link to the "Add Content to Process Docs" issue template

  ## Acceptance Criteria
  - [x] Content aligns with existing process docs
  - [x] Update improves clarity or closes a documented gap
  - [x] Proposed content has been reviewed with stakeholders (if needed)
labels: 
  - documentation
  - process improvement
